Second, three corrupt imported orders (ids 41-43) with NULL or 'N/A' values broke the revenue sum. I quarantined them into orders_quarantine and did not delete them. All 5 smoke tests now pass, with /stats at orders=40 and revenue=7887.5. The quarantined imports should be reviewed by a human and re-imported if valid.
